Criteria.TestCondition: All functionality can be accessed and executed using only the keyboard.
Criteria.TesterComment: We tabbed to every element, pressed Enter or Space on each custom control, and looked for anything a mouse can use that the keyboard cannot; we found nothing a keyboard user would miss. "#html5_media_6cfp06nko3p" can't be reached with the keyboard, but "play" (button) does the same thing (keyboard reaches video and its native controls). If you disagree, tell your assistant. Only the first 40 elements were checked for menus that open when the mouse rests on them. We looked for: things a mouse can click that the keyboard never reaches, including inside frames; menus that open when the mouse rests on them; custom controls that ignore Enter and Space; and tooltips with information found nowhere else. Results are for the browser used (version 153.0.8010.12).

Criteria.TestCondition: Individual keystrokes do not require specific timings for activation of functionality.
Criteria.TesterComment: The page mentions holding or timing (not about keys), but not for using the keyboard.

Criteria.TestCondition: There is no keyboard trap.
Criteria.TesterComment: We moved through the whole page with Tab and with Shift+Tab, and keyboard focus never got trapped. The page seems to load more content as you scroll, and the recording could not show all of it; content after the feed was reached only by Shift+Tab from the end. 15 collapsed control(s) (menus, accordions) were not opened; content behind them was not checked for traps.
